5 safe AI coding agent habits (Kiro permissions explained)

Five habits that keep AI coding agents from hurting you.

1. Supervise risky work - Use Supervised mode for anything sensitive.
2. Read every diff - Never accept changes you haven't read.
3. Careful with trust all - /tools trust-all skips approvals in the CLI.
4. Distrust new repos - Treat untrusted workspaces with care.
5. Keep secrets out - Never paste keys into prompts.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/ide/chat/autopilot/
